recipes.name: Native action / state / presentation composition
recipes.intent: Run a bounded playable mechanics carrier from engine-native scene, resource, action and signal responsibilities.
explicitGaps: Native fixture does not install Kenney assets, create soundtrack, or validate a third-party plugin.
Gameplay is a bounded rule-system fixture, not a shipped game.
recipes.nextFalsifier: Import one source-licensed UI + audio pack and compare actual input-to-signal and visual/audio feedback using the native scene.

recipes.name: Narrative exploration vertical slice
recipes.intent: Combine a small room/state loop with native dialogue provider, presentation, and sound rather than writing a new narrative DSL.
explicitGaps: Upstream Dialogue Manager 4.2.0 runs in the native example and mutates example-owned game state, but has not been connected to the room-encounter product.
Dialogue condition -> Game state effects need a product-owned binding.
Original soundtrack and character writing are not yet available.
recipes.nextFalsifier: Connect the verified source-locked native dialogue to real product quest state without inventing a dialogue compiler, then independently evaluate save/resume and actual player decisions.

recipes.name: Reactive 2D arena prototype substrate
recipes.intent: Assemble a small enemy combat loop with off-the-shelf AI, placeholder art and audio before bespoke systems.
explicitGaps: LimboAI GDExtension and build/architecture compatibility are not installed or validated.
Physics/hitboxes, actual player-control contract and NPC blackboard bindings are not tested.
Sprite scale and animation timing are currently unbound.
recipes.nextFalsifier: Install exact compatible LimboAI extension in a disposable Godot project; verify NPC signal-to-damage trace under real headless game state.

recipes.name: Bevy ECS mechanics prototype
recipes.intent: Compose Rust-native gameplay plugins and art imports from the Bevy ecosystem without routing through a Godot compatibility adapter.

components.integrationSeam: glTF export into Bevy asset loader
video export to compatible playback provider

explicitGaps: The original product-specific Bevy 0.20.1 App and Rust rules are now present in the real Game source and must pass its locked cargo test/check; GUI play and human acceptance have not been verified.
Third-party Bevy ecosystem plugins, imported art, music and cinematics have not been selected, installed or validated.
Godot addons cannot be treated as Bevy plugins; contract and runtime constraints are engine-specific.
recipes.nextFalsifier: Run the pinned Bevy Cargo.lock tests/check and exercise the desktop App against an actual display/input consumer; then bind a proven community plugin only for a missing mechanic.

recipes.name: Three-room combat and HUD native vertical slice
recipes.intent: Compose a bounded combat/guard/door/win-loss loop using native scenes, state resources, input, replaceable HUD, and existing Kenney CC0 sound without a universal combat framework.

components.integrationSeam: EncounterRules Node + typed encounter_tuning Resource + state_changed
native Buttons and keyboard input to attack/guard/advance/restart
encounter_view PackedScene replacement preserving rule state
EncounterAudio observes accepted attack/guard events and plays two license-recorded CC0 AudioStreams

explicitGaps: This is the native, headless-accepted three-room graybox only: no genuine player usability or full game release measurement.
Combat has no authored character sprites, soundtrack, animation pipeline, platform package or independent human playtest.
Kenney audio is game-local because Godot resource paths are project-relative, not an Ordivon audio engine.
recipes.nextFalsifier: Run the existing Godot 4.7 test:encounter and substitute native HUD/tuning/audio while checking a three-room win/loss and actual action feedback; then evaluate an actual packaged product.

recipes.name: CC0 two-avatar native appearance substitution
recipes.intent: Replace one Sprite2D appearance inside a PackedScene using pinned source-licensed PNG textures, independent of gameplay rules.

components.integrationSeam: two SHA256-pinned CC0 blue/green avatar PNGs -> Godot imported Texture2D

explicitGaps: Only a single visual-component swap is executed; this sample has no player input, game rules, world progression, soundtrack or product win state.
Exact source is a Git-pinned delivery mirror, while CC0 licensing authority remains Kenney original package; archive byte identity is not asserted.
Renderer/UI quality and human usability are not measured.
recipes.nextFalsifier: Run existing test:visual-native and replace native Sprite2D by PackedScene with different PNG dimensions while preserving node identity and world position; consume it inside a playable product before claiming Game execution.
